summary: Land acquisition under Land Acquisition Act, 1894 Sections 4 and 6 quashed; objections under Section 5A; compliance with mandatory audi alteram partem; distinction between Collector's recommendation and Government's decision; exemption for lands with authorized constructions; discrimination claim rejected; subsequent settlement terms proposed; doctrine of merger considered in prior appeals; High Court's re-appreciation improper when Collector's recommendation not binding.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment quashing acquisition notifications set aside; land acquisition proceedings restored pending compliance with Section 5A procedure; Respondents to comply with settlement conditions regarding land use.
